sources.name: VitaDB
sources.notes: Official VitaDB homebrew JSON feed. Requires POST with an empty body (no parameters). HTTPS is preferred; HTTP is used as fallback. Prefer this source over NeoVitaDB and VitaDBtoo when merging fields.

sources.name: NeoVitaDB
sources.notes: Static GitHub Pages catalog. Used when VitaDB lacks an entry or field.

sources.name: VitaDBtoo
sources.notes: Community rescue dump. Lowest priority among the three Vita catalogs; fills gaps only.
